criteria.requirement: Extend Interval.range with keyword-only closed=both/left/right/neither and limit=None/nonnegative integer, where left/right refer to traversal start/end. Preserve default inclusive two-end behavior, inverse direction, absolute and ANCHORED accumulated-step month-end restoration. Require positive index-protocol amount and valid units; reject zero/negative progress and invalid policies. Stop at finite emitted limit, same endpoint correctly, and avoid endpoint overflow. Limit counts yielded points; no sleeping or unbounded verification.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
